projects.title: SKUIComponents
projects.description: This is an UI components library for iOS in swift 3. It offers common IBDesignable UI components such as solid rounded button, gradient colored button, rounded image, gradient colored progress spinner, etc. The point is to make the components displayable and configurable on the storyboard/nib, so we can keep the in-code UI configuration to a minimum.
